rules.title: No deadline to apply
rules.lawQuote: [Sample text] A hospital shall not impose time limits for applying for charity care or discount payment.

rules.title: No asset test
rules.lawQuote: [Sample text] A hospital shall not use the patient's monetary assets in determining eligibility.

rules.title: Income proof: pay stubs or tax returns only
rules.lawQuote: [Sample text] Documentation of income shall be limited to recent pay stubs or income tax returns.

rules.title: No reporting to credit agencies
rules.lawQuote: [Sample text] A person shall not furnish information regarding medical debt to a consumer credit reporting agency.

rules.title: No liens on a home
rules.lawQuote: [Sample text] A hospital shall not use a lien on a patient's primary residence as a means of collecting unpaid bills.

rules.title: Can't require a Medi-Cal application first
rules.lawQuote: [Sample text] A hospital shall not deny charity care because the patient has not applied for Medi-Cal or another public program.
